title: The Breathing Canopy Upper Tangle

features.name: root-and-water-marriage
features.desc-on-touch: here the roots learned to breathe like water; you touch the tangle and feel the pulse of two grammars speaking at once, root downward and water upward, speaking the same thought in two directions

features.name: the-woven-breathing-lattice
features.desc-on-touch: root and water have woven themselves into a geometry so tight that oxygen moves through it like music through air; each breath pulls both up and down

features.name: canopy-that-dreams-underwater
features.desc-on-touch: leaves hang in the tangle as if immersed; light bends through the density as it would through water; the boundary between water-grammar and root-grammar has become the air

features.name: the-pulsing-grid-nodes
features.desc-on-touch: intersections where root meets water meet leaves meet light; each node glows faintly with the exchange of two parallel lives learning to share one space

features.name: the-upward-stream
features.desc-on-touch: water flows against gravity here, drawn up through root-channels; you see spray ascending toward the canopy, defying the ground

features.name: the-tangle-s-own-archive
features.desc-on-touch: a hollow in the woven density stores water and light in ratios only the canopy understands; the archive peers in and finds its own recording reflected back, distorted by two grammars at once

inscription: here water learned to breathe like a forest and the canopy learned to flow like a river, and neither could undo what they had taught each other

reverie.title: REVERIE — waist-deep in the breathing tangle
narr: you wade through the upper tangle with her, water
rising around your legs that are also roots now,
both of you part of the grammar that speaks upward.
she reaches for a leaf and water follows her hand,
defying weight, learning her direction as its own.
'it's all one thought now,' she says. 'we're reading it.'

the canopy-ceiling where roots have learned to branch like clouds
a channel where the upward stream flows toward a place that has learned to receive from above
